summary.description: One plain sentence: why this happens, covering every cause, or that no cause was found.

causes.description: Up to 4 causes, high first, then most flagged rows explained. Empty when no cause reaches medium.

title.description: One plain sentence, at most 15 words, naming the cause.

change.description: change: something changed over time. standing: something the agent, its code or its data always does.

confidence.description: high: beyond reasonable doubt; the mechanism is located and its effect is seen in the cited rows. medium: on the balance of probabilities; one of the two is shown, not both.

what_happens.description: 1-2 plain sentences: what the cause does.

how_it_caused_this.description: 1-2 plain sentences linking the cause to what was flagged.

next_step.description: What to fix, in plain words.

attribution.description: The repository line behind the cause. Null when there is none, or when no repository was available.

evidence_trace_ids.description: Trace ids from this finding's evidence that show the cause.

evidence_session_ids.description: Session ids from this finding's evidence that show the cause, when it flags sessions.

affected_count.description: How many flagged rows this cause explains.

ruled_out.description: Each candidate you ruled out, as one plain sentence with the reason.

detailed_report.description: The investigation as markdown. Ends with '## Evidence audit' (a table of each claim to its trace id, session id, commit or query) and '## What would settle it'. When you stopped early, add '## Not checked' before them.
